$comment: Registered inference rules for the Reasoning Engine (Phase 010 §5.2). Each rule is a Horn clause over registered relationship types: when every premise edge holds, the conclusion edge is inferred with the stated confidence multiplied by the premises' confidences. Inferences never achieve asserted standing without confirmation (IN-P7). Transitive closure of every relationship type registered as transitive is applied in addition to these rules.

rules.name: classification-inheritance
rules.statement: An entity classified under a taxon is classified under every broader taxon of that taxon.

rules.name: containment-dependency
rules.statement: A whole depends on what its parts depend on.

rules.name: governance-through-containment
rules.statement: A part is governed by the policies that govern its whole.

rules.name: disjointness-propagation
rules.statement: Whatever is narrower than one of two disjoint concepts is disjoint with the other.
